title: ME, VARANASI, BELOVED
author: Bharadwaj Mishra
text:
Remember Viswanath? You
told me many times, "Kashi,
you suffer what-not
in my name,
from never-ending funeral processions
trampling your peace
to crematorium ash all over
your sacrosanct body,
from misfortunes of hapless emperors
to heartbreaking sorrow of vilomahs.

“You tolerate odd wars
over who is bigger, Ram?
or the knower of Ram?
and the confusion of local governance
whether to focus on the holy place or
on the devotees, and again,
from you, me
or you from me?”

Enough, Viswanath! Just remember, I am
your ethereal carving
on your own creation,
yet I am the holiest stop
to all your creations.
Now it`s all the same, whatever they say,
you are for me,
or I am for you,
beloved forever.
